result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the bottom navigation appears to be missing the icon for the Orders tab.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar shows icons for Home, Search, and Profile, but the Orders tab only has a text label with empty space above it where an icon should be. This makes the navigation look inconsistent and may make the Orders tab less recognizable.
issues.suggestion: Add the appropriate Orders icon above the Orders label and align it consistently with the other bottom navigation items.
